How to build an AI employee in Claude Code — every step The part that surprises everyone: the agent is already built. Claude Code installs in one step, lives on your computer, and comes with the brain, the hands, and the loop inside — hand it a job and it plans, works, checks its own results, and keeps going until the job is finished. Your first build moment is one sentence: point it at your messiest folder and say "sort this out." Then watch. From there you evolve it into an employee, one piece at a time. An identity: a plain-language job description it reads automatically every time it wakes up — who it is, what it owns, your rules. Skills: playbooks for jobs done YOUR way, saved once — it reaches for the right one by itself when the job shows up. Memory: a notebook it reads when it starts and writes in when it learns, so every correction sticks. Connections: switch on your real email, calendar, and spreadsheets, and its work starts landing in your actual inbox. Then the step that changes everything: a schedule. Every morning at seven it starts alone — reads, sorts, drafts — before you've touched a key. Identity, playbooks, notebook, real tools, and a clock: the day it starts without you is the day an agent becomes an employee. And that's just the skeleton.
